**Adoption**
Resolution 2756 (2024) adopted 31 October 2024 (MAIN). 12 votes for, 0 against, 2 abstentions (Mozambique, Russia), 1 non-participating (Algeria).

**Amendments**
Algeria's S/2024/797 (nine-year absence note) failed 6–0–9 (AMEND). S/2024/798 (MINURSO monitoring expansion) failed 5–0–10 (AMEND).

**Algeria**
Abstained on MAIN due to perceived disregard for amendments (DZ-DRAFT). Rejected failure to incorporate monitoring functions (DZ-DRAFT).

**Switzerland**
Voted for MAIN (CH-B). Abstained on MINURSO monitoring amendment (CH-A) to preserve consensus. Did not vote on nine-year absence note (AMEND).

**Authority**
Mandate extended to 31 October 2025 (TEXT). OHCHR access urged but not mandated (TEXT). Adopted text did not add monitoring functions (TEXT).

Resolution 2756 (2024) adopted 31 October 2024 [MAIN]. 12 votes for, 0 against, 2 abstentions (Mozambique, Russia), 1 non-participating (Algeria) [MAIN].

Algeria's S/2024/797 (OHCHR visit note) received 6–0–9 [AMEND]. S/2024/798 (MINURSO monitoring expansion) received 5–0–10 [AMEND]. Neither adopted.

**Algeria**
Abstained on Resolution 2756 [DZ-DRAFT] due to non-adoption of amendments [DZ-DRAFT]. Rejected disregard for Sahrawi human rights; Sahrawi people must freely choose their future [DZ-DRAFT].

**Switzerland**
Voted for Resolution 2756 [CH-DRAFT]. Abstained on MINURSO monitoring amendment [CH-DRAFT] to preserve consensus, despite backing OHCHR access [CH-DRAFT].

**Authority**
